reader_summary.headline: We dive into the crazy, little-known story of how this small, former PC-maker in Cambridge, England dethroned Intel.
reader_summary.overview: We dive into the crazy, little-known story of how this small, former PC-maker in Cambridge, England dethroned Intel, saved Apple from bankruptcy. From Issac Newton to the Apple Newton, the Vision Fund and beyond, ARM has had an impact on the technology industry that cannot be overstated!
